name: observability-studio
description: Audit, instrument, verify, and inspect OpenTelemetry in Cursor, Kiro, Visual Studio Code, and Windsurf / Devin Desktop.

commands.title: Set Up SIS Sign-In with CIMD

observability-studio.sharedObserverUrl.markdownDescription: Optional shared `obstudio` base URL or `/mcp` URL override for the UI and MCP connection. Local shared Observers may use HTTP; non-local shared Observers must use HTTPS. When unset, the extension reuses or starts a managed local `obstudio` on `http://127.0.0.1:<managedObserverPort>`. A configured shared Observer's OTLP receiver ports are not remapped or validated.

observability-studio.managedObserverPort.markdownDescription: Local port used by the extension-managed Observer UI and MCP HTTP endpoint when `sharedObserverUrl` is unset.

observability-studio.sisCimdRegistration.markdownDescription: Feature flag (PoC): show the CIMD OAuth client setup control in the Cloud tab. Off by default so it does not appear for developers not working on the CIMD registration flow.

observability-studio.sisCimdOAuthIssuer.markdownDescription: SIS resource-group issuer URL used for Client ID Metadata Document (CIMD) sign-in. Loopback HTTP is accepted only for local development. Defaults to a local PoC SIS instance; override for demos. TODO: evaluate a real issuer discovery step (realm/tenant selection) before this goes beyond PoC.

observability-studio.sisCimdOAuthClientI.markdownDescription: Exact HTTPS URL of the CIMD client metadata document. SIS uses this document to create or refresh its public shadow client during authorization. Defaults to a local PoC metadata document; override for demos.

observability-studio.sisCimdOAuthRedirec.markdownDescription: Fixed loopback callback URI declared by the CIMD metadata document.

observability-studio.sisCimdOAuthScope.markdownDescription: Space-separated scopes requested for the CIMD public-client SIS session. Every scope must be declared by the metadata document and supported by SIS.

observability-studio.sisCimdOAuthDevelop.markdownDescription: Optional absolute PEM CA bundle path for loopback-only CIMD development. It augments standard roots only when both issuer and client metadata hosts are loopback and never disables TLS verification.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node build-observer.js && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node build-observer.js && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile-tests && node --test --experimental-test-coverage out/test/extension.test.js out/test/webview-html.test.js out/test/observer-lifecycle.test.js out/test/build-vsix.test.js out/test/startup-errors.test.js out/test/sis-cimd-oauth.test.js
scripts.test:integration: tsc --outDir out --rootDir src --module Node16 --target ES2022 --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop src/test/extension-integration.test.ts && node --test out/test/extension-integration.test.js
scripts.test:integration:smoke: tsc --outDir out --rootDir src --module Node16 --target ES2022 --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop src/test/extension-integration.test.ts && node --test --test-name-pattern="installed VSIX smoke test" out/test/extension-integration.test.js
scripts.test:host:current: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && vscode-test --run out/test/extension-vscode.test.js --fail-zero --timeout 30000
scripts.test:host:minimum: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && vscode-test --run out/test/extension-vscode.test.js --fail-zero --timeout 30000 --code-version 1.82.0 --grep "openObserver exposes validator summary"
scripts.test:host: npm run test:host:current && npm run test:host:minimum
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:host
